title: Cao P16: remove 34 commuting inverse ADDs with dual 632-column replay (no new kappa)
body:
## Scoped result: 34 fewer ADD macros on Cao Yifan's newer #4610 native word (NO new kappa)

On the **frozen, merged #4610** native word `CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds@20bb93cd990d2ff683e4d0fc56b87a42cd5d3296` (canonical payload SHA256 `cfcd36b40326d7a5815e1db5313444379b3fb756b27d5201c561574c085cc0dd`), find two exactly inverse rational scalar ADD operations separated only by commuting instructions and cancel the pair *in both native orientations*.

The 160-raw-event bounded scanner checked 542 matching inverse pairs, found 19 dual-legal commuting pairs, then selected **17 disjoint intervals**. Deleting those **34 ADD instructions** from the actual 21,449-event word and resynthesizing yields:
- Forward real scalar allowance **158120 -> 157808** (312 saved per native call).
- Backward real scalar allowance **158168 -> 157856** (312 saved per native call).
- The paid rank histogram is **identical**: `{1:2201, 2:412, 3:510, 4:127, 5:40, 8:8}` (3,298 local paid jobs).
- Every per-role native Fourier chart climb is preserved in **chronological order**. Every warp, owned centre, adapter and phase marker is unchanged.
- Two independent literal interpreters replay **all 632 arbitrary independent input columns, forward and inverse-transpose**, with `C0` cleared and the same full paid profile.
- An adversarial mutation removing just one of a matched inverse pair is **rejected**.
- The changed scalar word, complete invoice and source-pinned deleted-event patch are regenerated deterministically without a numerical optimizer.

The 18 local calls in the p16 controller imply 5,616 units of scalar-allowance headroom at the unchanged 18-call placement; this affects finite constants, **not** the claimed exponent. The selected #4470 ? and Cao #4610 conditional ?=0.0030217758 are unchanged. No end-to-end integer multiplier, new physical rank-changing primitive, global optimum or proof of a higher ? is asserted. Fixed-tape, stock/precision/analytic transfer retain original conditional contracts.

## Validation
On Windows Dell, source-bound CPython 3.13 run passed `combined_inverse_add_certificate.py` with both 632-column interpreters and the negative control, printing:

```
PASS_CAO_DUAL_632_SCALAR_CANCELLATION removed_pairs 17 forward_scalar_allowance 157808 backward_scalar_allowance 157856 native_pairs_preserved {'backward': True, 'forward': True}
```

A Python 3.11/3.13 Actions workflow is committed for hosted verification; hosted success is **not** asserted.

## Reproduce
```
python -I -B research/p16-cao-scalar-dag/inverse_add_dag_search.py /path/to/frozen-pr4610-checkout
python -I -B research/p16-cao-scalar-dag/combined_inverse_add_certificate.py /path/to/frozen-pr4610-checkout
```

## Credit / overlap
**Not a priority claim for scalar cancellation.** Cinna Davis's already merged **#4692** previously removed 116 ADDs from the **older selected #4470** word, using commuting and noncommuting rewrite patterns. This PR proves a smaller bounded commuting-inverse subset applies to Cao Yifan's **newer #4610** native word, with full dual tests; further application of #4692's broader compressor to the Cao word could improve on this number. Credit Cao Yifan/intqwq (#4610), Cinna Davis (#4470/#4692), Dugongue's transported native maps, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman, and all inherited authors. Authored for Chrisbryan17 with substantial GPT-6 assistance; Apache-2.0.

Research branches for independent follow-ups: `research/p16-cao-paid-fusion-20261023` (59 source-compatible F2-F2 candidates no positive legal one-contact fusion) and `research/p16-cao-controller-20261023` (all 16 retained prefix/suffix choices screened; selected 7/8 best and 8/7 ties in pure invoice). These are NOT part of the present PR.
